# ZoomLevel

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Defines the initial magnification used when a PDF is opened.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new ZoomLevel()
```

## Properties

- [`Custom`](#custom): Use a custom zoom level (specified in DocumentSettings)
- [`FitHeight`](#fitheight): Fit the page height within the window
- [`FitPage`](#fitpage): Fit the entire page within the window
- [`FitWidth`](#fitwidth): Fit the page width within the window
